The '''Quarantine Zone Survivor''' was a badge awarded to individuals who managed to survive within the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]], an area that suffered an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]]. Because of the terrifying circumstances within the area, it was one of the few awards presented to all factions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarantine Zone Survivor appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. The medal had three sets, each of which represented a specific faction (Imperial, Rebel, and neutral), and was developed alongside the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] itself to promote the then-upcoming book ''[[Death Troopers]]''.
